preconditions: Provenance basis: obtained by the owner's team through the official LRLPR-26 agreement; mirror held by the owner's team; owner attestation 2026-10-18; signed agreement and original download confirmation held by owner.
The official agreement admits academic researchers at educational or research institutions, for non-commercial use only.
Archive SHA-256 values are recorded on intake; the manifest is frozen from the extracted tree before any use.
Zenodo record 20422103 (restricted, third-party) is not accessed.

exposure.basis: A public ICPR 2026 competition dataset (269 teams registered); Scenario A is the earlier UFPR-SR-Plates release. Public plate recognisers may have trained on it; each instrument's exposure is recorded in its specification.
exposure.notes: Labels are semi-automatic (OCR on HR patches; the organisers note residual errors). Brazil/Mercosur plates only; plate crops only, so wrong-Track association cannot be measured.

nativeTaxonomy.definition: LRLPR-26 plate_layout 'Brazilian' (pre-Mercosur Brazilian plate, three letters and four digits).
nativeTaxonomy.name: Brazilian layout

release: LRLPR-26 competition-era archives (train 20,000 tracks; test-public 1,000 and test-blind 3,000 tracks without labels); train.zip SHA-256 fb95f86d8f5666ce7d2f577605d55516f9ec558d25944f870dfca8b7f7c9fb8f; full archive record in docs/qualification/stage4/lrlpr-26-dataset-record-2026-10-18.md

researchUse.basis: The LRLPR-26 agreement permits academic, non-commercial research use; MAVI is a non-commercial academic research project and the owner attests the agreement was signed and the data obtained under it. Redistribution, modification and commercial use are prohibited without the authors' permission: the data is never re-hosted, never committed and never placed in any shared or offline bundle; images appear only in academic publications and presentations; Laroca et al., ICPR 2026 is cited.

source.credibilityBasis: Provenance basis (owner decision): obtained by the owner's team through the official LRLPR-26 agreement; mirror held by the owner's team; owner attestation 2026-10-18; signed agreement and original download confirmation held by owner. The bytes were retrieved from that mirror (three Dropbox shared files and one GitHub LFS object, github.com/qwerty070806/lrlpr-2026); the two copies are byte-identical, and the structure matches the official README (20,000 train tracks, Scenario A 10,000 and Scenario B 10,000, 5 LR + 5 HR each). The authors publish no checksums, so byte identity with the authors' distribution is not independently verified.
